title: Roundness — the whole app at four levels

steps.path: Projects, the Themes popup, Resume Session and first-run sign-in, together
steps.headline: Buttons now follow the theme's roundness. Which level should the built-in themes use?
steps.notice: Cards, popups, buttons, tabs, filters and search boxes all move together at each level, so nothing is fixed as a pill any more. Community themes set their own level; this picks the default look.
steps.risk: Each picture is scaled down to fit four screens in one frame; use the zoom buttons to look closely.

variants.label: Sharp
variants.summary: Barely rounded. Buttons, tabs and search boxes 4px; cards and popups 6–10px.

variants.label: Soft
variants.summary: Today's built-in corner sizes, but buttons, tabs and search boxes all share one 8px corner — no pills.

variants.label: Round
variants.summary: Noticeably rounder. Buttons, tabs and search boxes 14px; cards and popups 18–24px.

variants.label: Pill
variants.summary: Every button, tab, filter and search box fully rounded; cards and popups 24–32px, like Halftone.
